<div class="section-heading">The Challenge</div>
<div class="section-divider"></div>

<div class="challenge-text">
  <a href="https://vast-challenge.github.io/2026/MC2.html" style="color:#E15759; font-weight:600;">VAST Challenge 2026 — Mini-Challenge 2</a>
  asks analysts to investigate an anomalous post made on SaidIT by John Windward on 17 May 2046.
  Map the activity, develop a baseline, compare it against the behaviour of interest,
  and suggest what might be done to prevent future issues.
</div>

<div class="section-heading">Research Questions</div>
<div class="section-divider"></div>

<div class="module-grid">
  <div class="module-card">
    <div class="module-number">Task 1</div>
    <h4>How was the anomalous post made?</h4>
    <p>Build a visual tool describing the sequence of events — the exact delegation chain and a system overview contextualising it within the full agent architecture.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="module-card">
    <div class="module-number">Task 2</div>
    <h4>What do the posts mean?</h4>
    <p>What is the origin of their contents? Illustrate the reasoning — including why the source files leave no recoverable trace in the event log.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="module-card">
    <div class="module-number">Task 3</div>
    <h4>Could this happen again?</h4>
    <p>Find prior occurrences. Illustrate at most one intervention point that would make recurrence more difficult — grounded in the data.</p>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="section-heading">Application Modules</div>
<div class="section-divider"></div>

<div class="module-grid">
  <div class="module-card">
    <div class="module-number">Module 01 · Brandon</div>
    <h4>System Topology &amp; Event Reconstruction</h4>
    <p>Interactive agent network and incident timeline. Trace the relay from james_stern to john_windward. Before/after topology comparison across three incident dates.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="module-card">
    <div class="module-number">Module 02 · Wee Tian</div>
    <h4>Content Source Anomaly &amp; Detection</h4>
    <p>The detection rule: content_source IS NOT NULL. Explore how the saidit_post_check validation gate passed all three incidents unchecked.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="module-card">
    <div class="module-number">Module 03 · Albert</div>
    <h4>Historical Patterns &amp; Intervention</h4>
    <p>Six agents present across all three incidents. Identical four-event terminal sequence at one-second precision. One null-check stops all of them.</p>
  </div>
</div>
